paragraphs.text: The Windgrace Acolytes are a Dominarian order of cat warriors on Urborg , who follow the anti-artifact principles of Lord Windgrace . They are vigilant against the spread of Phyrexia , and fly on pterodactyl-like creatures. It is said that they bear the memory of the war like soldiers bear battle scars.

Founded after the Phyrexian Invasion , they tended the Heroes' Memorial and used trained insects , called gladehunters , to track down artifice and artificers alike. They tried to discourage Venser from working on his ambulators .
After the coming of the Cabal and the Memorial's destruction by Belzenlok , the Acolytes fought to keep Urborg relics out of Cabal hands.
